{{Quote|Her whole life, my sister's suffered from a rare form of Mizra Syndrome.|[[Devar Gann]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Mizra Syndrome''' was a medical condition to which [[Human/Legends|Human]] were susceptible. [[Kindra Gann]] suffered from a rare form of the Syndrome since birth, but was cured by the [[Voss Mystics]] after a Pilgrimage to the [[Shrine of Healing]] on [[Voss]].
